Empower Your Communication Skills

Process Communication Model® (PCM) training for teams and open groups

16 hours · in Estonian, English or Russian · in Tallinn or on-site across Estonia

ask for training dates

What Participants Learn

We practice PCM in four steps 01

To be aware of your personality

Understanding your preferences means you need to be in a good place and how to fulfill those needs. In doing so, you can manage stress and take care of yourself.

02

To recognize what other people do, say, and show

Observing other people´s recognizable behavior reveals their preferences and the best way to approach them.

03

Adapt your communication style

Based on what you observe, you will know what to do, say, and show in response so that you can make a genuine connection that works for you both.

04

To build stronger relationships

Enjoy the benefits of positive daily interactions at work, in meetings, video calls, presentations, social situations – and at home, too.

How teams benefit from PCM training

Measured improvements in how teams work, communicate and feel*

2x fewer conflicts

Fewer misunderstandings and less time lost on miscommunication.

Greater team comfort

Clearer and more effective communication between team members.

Stronger mutual understanding

Better understanding of individual differences and working styles.

More balanced participation

Work contribution becomes more evenly distributed, with more voices actively involved.

Higher satisfaction

Teams feel more satisfied with both collaboration and results.

Stronger team stability

Team members show less desire to leave, creating a more stable and supportive environment.

Choose the format that fits your goals, whether you are starting or going deeper

Training formats

Not sure which format fits you? I´ll help you choose.

request training dates

PCM® Core Training

Start here

A practical introduction to the Process Communication Model®.

You will learn to recognise different personality types, adapt your communication, and handle everyday situations with more clarity and ease.

  • 16 hours of training
  • includes your personal PCM profile
  • suitable for individuals and teams

PCM® Leadership

Or start here, if you are a leader or a manager

Learn how to support your team, adapt your leadership style, and create a more trusting and effective communication culture.

  • 16 hours of training
  • includes your personal PCM Leadership profile
  • practical tools for leadership situations
  • understanding team dynamics
  • supporting motivation and wellbeing

PCM® Advanced Training

For those who want to deepen their skills.

Built on the core/leadership training and develops your ability to navigate more complex situations, stress patterns, and communication dynamics.

  • built on the Core Training
  • more practice and real-life application
  • deeper understanding of behaviour and stress

Your personal PCM profile

The training starts with your personal PCM profile. It is a detailed and practical insight into how you communicate, what motivates you, and how you react under stress.

This means you are not just learning a model —
you are learning how it works for you.

This is what makes PCM training deeply personal and immediately applicable.

Example page from your 26-page personal PCM profile

What Our Clients Say

Thanks to PCM, I can understand my conversation partner and the situation more quickly. This means that less energy is expended and decisions are made more quickly. I did the training with my employees. We got to know each other better and realised that our personalities are a perfect match. This knowledge improves communication and makes us more successful! Now I have the tools to adapt to different communication styles and avoid unnecessary conflicts. Special thanks for your energy and ability to explain complex things in simple language. It was not only informative, but also really interesting!
